objective: Write the source-witnessed AC1027 TABLECONTENT cell containing two repeated block CONTENT records followed by a string scalar, retaining exact target order and transactional failure behavior.

implementation.admission: Supports only the witnessed no-attribute three-content sequence [block, same block, string] in the rectangular TABLECONTENT writer. Each block target must resolve uniquely to an emitted BLOCK_RECORD and uniquely named/owned block. Other unqualified multiplicities remain refused.
implementation.serialization: Writes each remapped block target in source order, followed by the scalar value; existing one-block and attributed-block profiles retain their prior rules. Adapter binding indexes requested block identities once with bounded content, attribute and target counts.
implementation.fixture_policy: Controls are generated locally at runtime; no DWG/DXF fixture file was added or committed.

proof.ascii_binary_wire: For both ASCII and Binary DXF, physical output inspection confirms the target cell group 95 count is 3, ordered CONTENT types [4,4,1], the first two group-340 values equal the same emitted BLOCK_RECORD handle, and both block group-91 attribute counts are zero. The neighboring scalar cell is also checked.
proof.typed_readback: Fresh readback confirms a 1x2 table; the first cell contains both block references to the emitted BLOCK_RECORD followed by the expected string and no attributes; the second cell retains its scalar.
proof.failure_retry: For both output encodings, changing only the second repeated block target to a missing handle refuses export and preserves the existing sentinel file. Restoring the valid handle lets the same writer instance export successfully.
proof.compatibility: The same focused block test retains and verifies the already-supported attributed mixed-content block grid and multiple block cells; the FIELD multi-cell reference selector passes alongside it.

validation.result: 2/2 passed; block selector covers ASCII and Binary; elapsed focused cohort about 0.55 seconds.
validation.full_suite: Not run; this is a narrow TABLECONTENT serializer/adapter slice.

scope_limits: Does not qualify arbitrary block-content order, distinct repeated block targets, attributes on repeated-block cells, linked-data combinations, or block geometry payloads.
Does not establish native TABLE rendering or broader DWG/DXF support claims.
plan_action: Remove the repeated [block, block, string] TABLECONTENT composition from P5. Keep independent block geometry-payload witness and semantics work open.
